title: Second-Domain Coexistence & Authority Replication, Stable Context-Basis Completion, Cross-Coordinate Independence Stress, Dependency-Graph Intervention, Primitive Merge/Split Falsification, Context-Basis Transport & the Court of Whether X Admits a Reproducible Minimal Primitive Basis

primary_targets.COEXISTENCE_REQUIREMENT: Obtain a second exact cross-domain discriminator with compatibility obligation held fixed.
primary_targets.RELEASE_AUTHORITY: Obtain a second exact cross-domain discriminator with lifecycle phase held fixed.

basis_falsification.independence: For each retained coordinate, require at least one intervention under which it varies while all other retained coordinates and material G,E are fixed.
basis_falsification.merge_attack: Attempt to replace any pair of coordinates by one quotient variable; reject the merge only if separate interventions yield different actions under matched residual state.
basis_falsification.split_attack: Attempt to split each candidate primitive into finer subcoordinates; permit a split only if the subcoordinates are prospectively identifiable and each carries independent action discrimination.
basis_falsification.deletion_attack: Delete each coordinate from the reconstructed basis and test whether action distinctions collapse.
basis_falsification.transport: A stable basis claim requires reproduction in at least two software domains for every stable primitive and no domain-specific coordinate added after outcomes.

promotion_rule.stable_primitive: Two exact cross-domain discriminator families plus representation-invariant replay, one negative control, and survival of merge/deletion attack.
promotion_rule.minimal_basis: Every retained coordinate must survive deletion; every pairwise merge must lose at least one independently replicated action distinction; no redundant coordinate may remain.
promotion_rule.bounded_only: One exact domain remains bounded and cannot count toward basis completion.

literature_and_data_custody.audit: Identify literature/data already used by EvoNOMOS that is absent from Drive, distinguish repository/web mentions from actual retained files, and provide DOI or stable links for genuinely missing high-value sources.
literature_and_data_custody.no_result_dependence: Literature findings may narrow novelty claims or suggest later tests but may not retroactively alter P15 promotion criteria.

r2_gate: LAW-R2 remains unauthorized unless fresh normalized same-(X,G,E) conflicting action survives all permitted basis reconstruction.
